messages:
Sasha: Deploybot started canary for service-x on v1.24.0 — seeing p95 jumps during ramp. Tagging @Oncall-SRE @Ryan @Emily. Please advise if we should pin and fallback. links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/backout-procedure and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-checklist

deploy-bot: Canary started for service-x · canary-id=cb-3781234567 · metrics: p95 +38% vs baseline, error-rate 0.7% -> 2.1% (threshold 1.0%) · samples=1200 · monitoring window=2m · auto-pause not fired (policy: 5m sustained) :rotating_light:

Ryan: on it. That p95 delta is over our rolling threshold. Recommend temporary pin to last stable tag v1.23.8 and enable fallback routing for user-facing endpoints. If p95 > +25% sustained for 2m or errors >1.5% for 2m, trigger rollback.

Emily: agree with Ryan. Can someone run the pin command and notify infra for traffic shift? Also update the release notes with a rollback note.

Marco: Pin command (run from deployctl host):

```
rollout pin service-x --tag v1.23.8 --reason "canary latency regression"
```

Also run: `deployctl enable-fallback service-x --route prod-cold` to divert new sessions. Runbook excerpt: Follow backout checklist -> Step 3: pin, Step 4: traffic-shift, Step 5: verify telemetry.

Oncall-SRE: Taking the pin now and will coordinate traffic shift with infra. ETA ~90s. I will also attach a link to the postmortem doc skeleton: https://redwood.internal/pm/svcx-regression

deploy-bot: Pin request acknowledged. Executing pin...

deploy-bot: Pin applied · service-x pinned to v1.23.8 · previous active tag v1.24.0 (canary) · canary hold initiated · canary-id=cb-3781234567

Sasha: Thanks — canary hold in place. I've logged the action in the release tracker and added a short note under change-window 2026-03-20.

Ryan: Please capture quick logs for the 10m window so SRE/ML can inspect model latency patterns: `kubectl logs -l app=service-x -n prod --since=10m > /tmp/sx-canary.log` and upload to the incident blob storage (https://storage.redwood.internal/cases/3781234567).

Emily: I've updated the release notes draft to include the temporary pin and reasoning: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/service-x-2026-03-20 (added a "rollback during canary" section).

Oncall-SRE: Traffic shift executed. Observed metrics after pin: p95 trending back toward baseline, errors down to ~0.8%. Monitoring for a 15m stabilization window. Will add if we need to fully roll back across all regions.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update (2m post-pin): p95 -7% vs baseline, error-rate 0.8% · canary-id=cb-3781234567

Sasha: Great. Leaving the pin in place until the end of the change window and marking this as an emergency pin action in the release notes. If things remain stable we'll schedule a controlled rollout of v1.24.0 after a root-cause and targeted fix. :thumbsup:

Ryan: Please schedule a postmortem if the regression surfaces in other services. Also add the sampling traces to the ML perf board for model-level regression hunting.

Emily: Noted — I'll create the postmortem template and link logs.

Oncall-SRE: Closing immediate action. Will follow up in #postmortems with timeline and traces once the 15m window completes.

Sasha: Thanks team — good run.
